caption: The drawing depicts a section of architectural detail, focusing on a stone or plaster element featuring geometric and organic patterns. The central portion displays a vertical rectangle with a stylized symmetrical design resembling interconnected lines and loops, rendered in off-white against a greenish-blue background. Surrounding this central rectangle, the adjacent surfaces are similarly colored in greenish-blue, bordered and accented with reddish-brown edges and curved motifs. The upper area of the object appears unfinished or worn, depicted in light gray tones, possibly indicating stone or erosion. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with the depicted object occupying the central area of the composition. The artist’s signature, "Ruth Miller," is inscribed in small text at the lower right of the object.
title: Carved and Painted Keystone
